style: Cold dimensional-metal hero/B-anchor still composition — a held studio-lit product shot of two hand-illustrated machined-metal forms on a near-black stage, not a kinetic word-reveal. Material realism is built entirely from layered CSS/SVG gradients, radial layers, blur/filters, and clip-paths (no photographic or fetched assets). Single raking key light (left-to-right) across both forms; cold graphite die lower-left (subordinate, unlit, mid-tumble frozen on edge) and a dominant (~55% of frame) machined aperture/iris-eye form on the right, fully shut, absolutely no emissive glow — dormant, inert metal, 'the eye has not opened yet.' Distinct near/mid/far depth layers for parallax, shallow depth of field, soft contact shadows, faint specular glints on bevels. Mood: restrained, ominous, dormant — a luxury-object product shot crossed with a sci-fi dormant-machine tease.

scenes.emotion: cold, dormant, ominous restraint — ambient dread ahead of an unrevealed judgment
scenes.motion: Caption is a static hold, not a kinetic word-reveal: a single slow fade/settle-in (~0.4-0.6s) and then it sits fixed, extra-condensed caps, warm-bone #EDE8DD, min height ~8% of frame height, lower-center between the two metal forms, inside the title-safe inner 90%. All perceptible motion in the shot instead lives in the background/foreground dimensional scene: slow parallax drift across the near/mid/far depth layers, a faint specular sheen slowly crawling across the metal bevels (peaking around the beat below), and a very subtle settle/breathing micro-motion on the die. No aperture-opening motion of any kind — the iris stays shut throughout.
